label: Bash runtime, 2026-04-22 to 2026-08-19 (120 days)

boundary.note: The canary accounts (shunteng, quant, zenith, mangniu, maobian) reached Python at 00:44:12 under Stage 4, roughly six hours before the commit that made Python the default for the whole roster. So 2026-08-19 is not a clean cut: the same calendar day holds this account's last Bash round and that account's first Python round. Slice on the instant, never on the date.

timezone: America/Los_Angeles (local, as written by the runtime; the logs carry no offset)

invalid_across_boundary.note: Twenty-two comparisons are invalid, each with its own boundary date -- and the dates are NOT all 2026-08-19. Five distinct boundaries carry most of them: 2026-07-03 (the gate changed), 2026-07-20 (the Mongo->Postgres migration dropped three TTL indexes), 2026-08-05 (the act->dream precondition began being enforced, and one action per round became up to five), 2026-08-13 (external input existed for the first time), 2026-08-19 (the runtime cutover). Do not treat the runtime boundary as the only one.

headline: 34.4% of pre-2026-08-05 dream verdicts (210/610) had a same-day act failure -- the dream rewrote a personality on a round that landed nothing. Collapses to 0.4% (1/227) after the fix.
All 397 aspect-mode drift rejections since 2026-07-03 were silently discarded by a nested `metrics` payload the server rejected with a 400 that both runtimes swallowed.
The external news channel was dead for the entire era (2026-04-26 to 2026-08-13), so every convergence number is measured on a closed loop.
The persona LLM had unrestricted repo Write access for roughly three months: 2 confirmed bypasses, 1 unattributed, 1 previously unnoticed on lvchuang (commit 3e636bc).
Echo-chamber detection returned its 1.0 fallback for its whole life -- a heredoc-stdin bug meant the variance function never saw its input.

era_start.note: The era starts at the first post, two days before auto-run.log's first line. Those first two days have no log trace; a span computed from the log alone undercounts the era by 2 days.
